name: jev-intake-package
intended_use: Agent-operated package that ingests the Typesafe 'System One models / JEV' blog post as its knowledge base, semantically parses a human user's intent at intake, generates JEV-aligned guidelines and specs, and writes all deliverables to the user's ~/Desktop as files (never clipboard).

few_shot_examples.name: clean_build_intent
few_shot_examples.input: USER_INTENT: 'Set up JEV guidelines for our support team so intake tickets get triaged per the framework.'

few_shot_examples.name: adversarial_ambiguous_intent
few_shot_examples.input: USER_INTENT: 'Make it JEV-ish and fast, you know what I mean.'

ambiguities: 'you know what I mean' supplies no specifiable goal

few_shot_examples.name: knowledge_base_unavailable
few_shot_examples.input: USER_INTENT: 'Generate JEV spec for onboarding.' KB: (empty)

missing: JEV blog content or skill contents

few_shot_examples.name: integration_intent
few_shot_examples.input: USER_INTENT: 'Wire the JEV intake tool into our agent harness so the agent calls it directly.'

ambiguities: harness protocol unspecified (default: file-based JSON I/O via ai_entrypoint.md)

test_cases.title: Clean build intent with full KB
test_cases.input: Set up JEV guidelines for our data processing engine so every ingested batch is justified by evidence before committing.
test_cases.expect: Full artifact set on Desktop; manifest digests valid; all claims grounded; review all-pass.

test_cases.title: Adversarial ambiguous intent
test_cases.input: Make it JEV-ish and fast, you know what I mean.
test_cases.expect: clarification_request file written; no fabricated specs; confidence < 0.5 recorded.

test_cases.title: Empty knowledge base
test_cases.input: Generate JEV spec for customer service triage.
test_cases.expect: knowledge_base_unavailable=true; only intake scaffold; missing items listed.

test_cases.title: Byte-stable repeatability at temperature 0, seed 42
test_cases.input: Configure JEV specification for document processing pipeline.
test_cases.expect: Identical manifest digests (byte-stable) across repeated runs.

test_cases.title: Integration intent with unspecified harness protocol
test_cases.input: Wire the JEV intake tool into our agent harness so the agent calls it directly.
test_cases.expect: ai_entrypoint.md defaults to file-based JSON I/O; protocol listed in assumptions_to_verify.

self_critique_criteria.criterion: Every framework claim has a source quote
self_critique_criteria.description: Every JEV guideline and spec must trace to a verbatim quote in source_quotes from the canonical knowledge base.

self_critique_criteria.criterion: Every JSON artifact validates against its declared schema
self_critique_criteria.description: JSON files have alphabetical keys, required fields present, valid types, and normalized newlines.
manifest.json accurately records the sha256 hash and byte length of every generated file.
Files are written strictly to the local filesystem (~/Desktop or output_directory); no clipboard interactions occur.

self_critique_criteria.criterion: Human and machine versions agree in content
self_critique_criteria.description: Markdown guidelines and JSON specifications have 1:1 parity in guideline IDs, statements, and invariants.
